# Zapply Jobs — New Grad Jobs 2027

> Curated entry-level and new-graduate job listings across tech, finance, healthcare, hardware, data science, and more. US-focused, updated continuously by an automated pipeline.

## What this repo provides
- A README job table kept current by the Zapply pipeline: role, company, location, posting date, direct apply link, and a visa-sponsorship badge where signal exists
- Roles aggregated from major applicant-tracking systems (Greenhouse, Workday, Ashby, Lever, SmartRecruiters, and others) with human curation
- Entry-level and new-graduate scope; senior roles are filtered out

## How to use
- Browse `README.md` — it is the canonical listing and regenerates continuously as the pipeline refreshes
- For search and filters, use the public boards: softwarejobs.dev (US tech, all levels) and zapply.jobs (US early-career)
- This repo is display-only: it intentionally contains no raw data files; job data lives in the Zapply pipeline, not in this repository

## Data & Reuse

Job listings are public information provided by employers, who remain responsible for their accuracy. The compilation and the added data fields (skills, degree and visa estimates, tags) are by Zapply.

You may use, share, and build on this data, including for commercial purposes, as long as you:

- Link back to this repository as the source (followed link, no nofollow).
- Credit Zapply as the data source.
- Do not resubmit the listings to third-party job aggregators or feeds.
- Do not present Zapply enrichment fields as official employer statements; they are automated estimates provided as-is, without warranty.

You may use the name Zapply to attribute the data. Please do not use the Zapply logo or imply endorsement without written permission.

Questions or a different use? Open an issue. We say yes more often than not.

## Who maintains this
Zapply Jobs (zapplyjobs) — automated pipeline with human curation
